wireEncoding: JSON.stringify, parsed as event.data in both directions
validateIncoming: event.source must equal the chosen iframe.contentWindow, and event.origin must equal new URL(iframe.src).origin after actual runtime verification; do not hard-code a development origin or permit remote navigation
correlation: Add requestId to each request; export responses echo the complete request in response.message (response.message.requestId)

svg.response: event:export format:svg data=<SVG text> xml=<whole source file>
svg.pageScope: Active graph only; pageId/currentPage are not honored by SVG branch. Send a single-page mxfile as xml, or switch the editor page through an explicit host adapter.

png.response: event:export format:xmlpng data=<data:image/png;base64> xml=<whole source file>
png.pageScope: pageId selects a page; currentPage=true selects active page; otherwise first page. Embedded XML retains all supplied pages. Test viewState/background fidelity for non-active page; one-page XML gives a stable host export boundary.

exports.multiPage: XML retains all pages. For separate SVG/PNG pages use serialized one-page XML snapshots and separate requestIds, restoring the live document after export; for PDF the host owns pagination. No action:export PDF branch is present.

html.response: event:export format:xml xml=<all mxfile pages>, message=<original request>; host builds the portable viewer document from this XML.
html.hostBuild: Create a .mxgraph element with data-mxgraph JSON containing xml, nav:true, resize:true, toolbar:"pages zoom layers lightbox" and desired initial page. Inline the complete published js/viewer-static.min.js as a classic script. Do not keep core html2 meta-refresh/editor logo link.
html.viewer: js/viewer-static.min.js contains the pinned official viewer plus a local bootstrap and legacy compressed-div compatibility. js/embed-static.min.js is its small legacy alias.

coreHtml2.response: event:export format:html2 data=<HTML with editor meta-refresh in EmbedFile mode> xml=<whole mxfile>
coreHtml2.cause: Export handler calls getFileData(...html=true). createFileData assigns its redirect URL to window.location.href for EmbedFile MODE_EMBED; getHtml2 emits meta-refresh and logo link instead of viewer script when redirect URL is non-null.
coreHtml2.options: No JSON export option to suppress this redirect is read by the shipped handler. allPages is not read by either HTML branch.

legacySinglePage.requires: Editor URL pages=0 AND this.pages absent or length <= 1. For >1 pages, html takes the same redirected html2 branch.
legacySinglePage.response: event:export format:html data=<legacy compressed-div HTML with local embed-static script> xml=<active mxGraphModel>
legacySinglePage.scope: Single active graph only; not the portable multi-page export contract.

html.standalone: Host owns portable document assembly and embedded images/fonts/math resources. Private Tauri or development URLs are not portable dependencies.

evidence.analystReadableSource: readable/app.js (formatting aid linked to the exact minified member)
evidence.runtimeConfirmation: Synthetic fixture-export.html contains a local editor meta-refresh and no viewer script, matching this EmbedFile path.

viewer.basis: Exact official source before local wrapper, classic-script static reads only.

viewerKeys.toolbar: Space-separated item names. The pages token creates previous/next controls and an n / total counter, visible only when diagram count > 1. zoom/layers/lightbox add those tools.
viewerKeys.page: Zero-based initial page index; parsed with parseInt(config.page) || 0.
viewerKeys.pageId: Optional diagram ID read by the viewer initialization; page remains the simple initial index contract.
viewerKeys.nav: Controls editor folding/navigation behavior via urlParams.nav; it is not the page-switcher flag.
viewerKeys.resize: Controls viewer/container sizing; it is not the page-switcher flag.
viewerKeys.pages_or_pageSwitcher: No graphConfig.pages or pageSwitcher option is read by this exact viewer. Use the pages token in toolbar and retain all <diagram> nodes in xml.

runtimeLimits: PNG depends on the browser foreignObject-to-canvas probe. With no remote export server a failed probe yields the upstream blank image fallback; host should detect failure rather than claim success.
Passing export.xml replaces the live editor file data. Run host exports serially in a dedicated export iframe, or snapshot and restore the live document; do not overwrite accepted edits.
save clears modified immediately unless keepmodified=1; durable-write acknowledgment belongs to host and may set status.modified=false.
Standalone HTML must inline its viewer dependency and any required media/fonts/math resource; a Tauri-hosted resource URL cannot be assumed accessible outside the application.

Core action:export html2 in EmbedFile mode yields an editor-redirect HTML, not a portable viewer. Portable multi-page HTML must be assembled by the host from XML; there is no noRedirect JSON option in the shipped export handler.
